title: Land of the Giants #1 Gold Key 1968 Photo Cover Silver Age Irwin Allen TV Comic
conditionDescription: Marker "25c" on the front cover, heavy spine and edge wear, creasing, small chips, toning. Reading copy. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
descriptionText:
Land of the Giants #1 (November 1968, Gold Key, 10230-811) -- first issue of the TV tie-in comic, with the photo cover of the Irwin Allen cast. Back cover carries the American Specialty "Make Money, Get Prizes" Christmas Packs ad. Cover price 15c.

Condition: Good / reading copy, priced accordingly. "25c" written in marker on the front cover over the price, heavy spine and edge wear with creasing and small chips, toning throughout, and wear to the back cover (see close-ups). Complete. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
